questions.question: When the road has a solid yellow line and a broken yellow line, with the broken line next to your lane, when can you pass?

options.text: If you are on an expressway.

questions.correctAnswerText: If traffic is clear.
questions.explanation: When a broken yellow line is next to your lane, you may cross it to pass if no oncoming traffic is coming.

questions.question: What color are the lines that separate traffic moving in opposite directions?
questions.correctAnswerText: Yellow
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions.

questions.question: What do downward-facing triangular signs mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Tell drivers to yield.
questions.explanation: Downward-facing triangular signs tell drivers to yield. You may go when the road is clear and safe.

questions.question: How can you avoid hitting vehicles in your blind spots?

options.text: Turn your head to check your blind spot before changing lanes.
Adjust your rearview mirrors every few minutes.
Honk your horn right before turning or changing lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head to check your blind spot before changing lanes.
questions.explanation: Before turning or changing lanes, turn your head and look over your shoulder to see if your blind spot is clear. Do not rely on mirrors alone.

questions.question: What does a single dashed yellow line mean?

options.text: Drivers may pass if it is safe to do so.
Both lanes travel in the same direction.
Drivers may pass, even if it could be dangerous.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers may pass if it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A dashed yellow line means you may pass if it is safe. Do not pass if oncoming traffic is present.

questions.question: What affects your ability to stop?
questions.correctAnswerText: The condition of the road.
questions.explanation: Road conditions greatly affect how quickly you can stop. On slippery roads, you need to slow down to stay in control.

questions.question: When crossing a railroad track with no signals or gates, what should you do?

options.text: You have the right-of-way and do not need to check for trains.
You may pass slower drivers while crossing the track.
Make sure your vehicle has space to cross completely without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure your vehicle has space to cross completely without stopping.
questions.explanation: Check that you have enough room to completely cross the tracks before driving on them. Do not pass other vehicles at a railroad crossing. Always look for trains before crossing.

questions.question: What is a speed limit?

options.text: The maximum or minimum legal speed under dangerous conditions.
The maximum or minimum legal speed under ideal conditions.
The suggested speed under ideal conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum or minimum legal speed under ideal conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit is the legal speed you can travel under ideal conditions. You can drive slower than the posted speed, but you cannot drive faster. Drive slower in school zones, work zones, and bad weather.

questions.question: What color lines divide lanes moving in the same direction?
questions.correctAnswerText: White
questions.explanation: White lines divide lanes moving in the same direction. Broken white lines can be crossed to pass. Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions.

questions.question: When is it illegal to drive below the speed limit?

options.text: When driving slowly disrupts the normal flow of traffic
When in heavy traffic in a construction zone
Only when driving in rural areas.
When driving under adverse weather conditions

questions.correctAnswerText: When driving slowly disrupts the normal flow of traffic
questions.explanation: Driving too slowly can disrupt traffic flow and is illegal. You may receive a ticket for driving too slowly.

questions.question: On a road with no sidewalks, where should a pedestrian walk?

options.text: On the side with the lightest traffic.
On the same side as traffic is moving.
On the side facing oncoming traffic.
On the side with the heaviest traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: On the side facing oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: Walk on the side of the road where you face oncoming traffic.

questions.question: When pulling out of a driveway onto a street, you must:

options.text: Drive slowly so vehicles and pedestrians have time to move.
Honk your horn so others know to make room for you.
Stop and only go when no pedestrians or vehicles are coming.
Ignore pedestrians if there is no sidewalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and only go when no pedestrians or vehicles are coming.
questions.explanation: Always stop before entering the road from a driveway. Give the right of way to all pedestrians and vehicles. You must stop before crossing the sidewalk. Failing to stop is against the law.

questions.question: Hydroplaning is usually caused by:
questions.correctAnswerText: Driving too fast.
questions.explanation: At high speeds, your tires cannot push water off the road. They lose grip and slide on a layer of water. This is hydroplaning.

questions.question: Drinking coffee after drinking alcohol:

options.text: Does not change blood alcohol level.

questions.correctAnswerText: Does not change blood alcohol level.
questions.explanation: Coffee does not lower your blood alcohol level. It may keep you awake, but it cannot make you sober.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is red.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
The traffic light ahead is green.
There is a traffic light ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic light ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is at the next intersection.

questions.question: To pass a slower vehicle on a two-lane road with traffic in both directions, you must:

options.text: Flash your lights at oncoming cars.
Use the lane for oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use the lane for oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: Passing on a two-lane road requires you to use the oncoming traffic lane. Only pass if it is safe and legal.

questions.question: When parking uphill on a hill with a curb, turn your front wheels:
questions.correctAnswerText: Sharply away from the curb.
questions.explanation: Turn your wheels sharply away from the curb so your car does not roll into traffic if the brakes fail.

questions.question: Which light tells you to slow down and be careful at an intersection?
questions.correctAnswerText: A flashing yellow light
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down, be careful, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: How should you use a freeway exit ramp?

options.text: Slow down before entering the exit ramp.
Slow down after you enter the exit ramp.
Keep your speed the same on the exit ramp.
Pass slower cars in the exit ramp.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down after you enter the exit ramp.
questions.explanation: Do not slow down until you are on the exit ramp.

questions.question: What is a "No zone"?

options.text: The blind spot around a large truck
An area for motor vehicles only

questions.correctAnswerText: The blind spot around a large truck
questions.explanation: "No zones" are blind spots around trucks and large vehicles. Avoid staying in these areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Do not enter.
questions.explanation: This sign appears at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot drive in that direction.

questions.question: If you need to stop quickly and your vehicle does not have an Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS), you should:
questions.correctAnswerText: Firmly pump your brakes.
questions.explanation: Pumping the brakes is the best way to stop in an emergency. Your car will stop quickly and you can still steer.

questions.question: When driving past a parked car on the side of the road, you should:

options.text: Assume the driver will open the car door as you approach.
Assume the driver will wait for you to pass before opening the door.

questions.correctAnswerText: Assume the driver will open the car door as you approach.
questions.explanation: A parked driver may open their door suddenly as you pass. Use extra caution when driving near parked vehicles.

questions.question: Coming to a complete stop, yielding to other traffic and pedestrians, and then proceeding when it is safe matches which traffic light?
questions.correctAnswerText: A flashing red light.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same as a stop sign. You must stop completely, yield to other traffic and pedestrians, and then go when it is safe.

questions.question: Roads freeze quickly when they are:
questions.correctAnswerText: Shaded.
questions.explanation: Shaded areas freeze faster than sunny areas. In cold or wet weather, be careful on roads shaded by trees or buildings. These areas are the last to dry.

questions.question: A driver with a Graduated Driver License:

options.text: Does not need to use a seat belt.
Must follow only the same rules as a basic driver license holder.
Cannot use any cell phone while driving.
Can use electronic devices while driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cannot use any cell phone while driving.
questions.explanation: A Graduated Driver License holder cannot use any cell phones or electronic devices while driving. All drivers must wear a seat belt.

questions.question: A driver age 21 or older with a Graduated Driver License must practice supervised driving for at least ____ before taking the road test.
questions.correctAnswerText: Three months
questions.explanation: A driver under 21 must practice supervised driving for at least six months. A driver age 21 or older must practice for at least three months before taking the road test.

questions.question: A flashing yellow light at an intersection means you should:

options.text: Slow down and proceed with care.
Stop and proceed when a green light appears.
Stop and proceed when the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with care.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means caution. Slow down, look both ways, and proceed carefully.

questions.question: You are backing out of your driveway and see children nearby. Before you move your car, you should:

options.text: Rev your engine to warn the children.
Sound your horn so the children hear you.
Walk to the back of the car to check if the way is clear.
Tell the children to stay away from the driveway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Walk to the back of the car to check if the way is clear.
questions.explanation: Always get out and look behind your vehicle before backing up. Your mirrors may not show everything, especially children. Do not rely only on mirrors.

questions.question: Car drivers should know that large trucks:

options.text: Can stop more quickly than cars.
Do not need more room to maneuver than cars.

questions.correctAnswerText: Have large blind spots.
questions.explanation: Large trucks have large blind spots in front, on the sides, and in the back. Avoid these areas. Trucks need more room to stop and maneuver than cars.
